ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for >95% of the visible surface area; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to isolated focal points and edge reflections.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity field across both lobes; distinct high-intensity (white) pixel clusters are localized at the far-right distal tip and sporadic high-intensity specks are distributed near the central medial ridge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 1/6th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations increase significantly at the far-left distal margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a concave curve initiating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels at the far right distal tip and lower right lobe surface, consistent with localized high-intensity pixel grouping.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions detected on the mid-left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the vertical peduncle axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss at the far-left distal lobe tip, creating a non-symmetrical profile relative to the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent vertical high-intensity pixel gradient representing a raised structural ridge at the intersection of the peduncle and the fluke surface.
